title_sq: Tek Liqeni I Thate, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2 Me Hapesira Perfekte Ideal Per Banim!!!
description_sq: Tek Liqeni I Thate, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2 Me Hapesira Perfekte Ideal Per Banim!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin 3 banim te nje pallati me 6 kate dhe ka siperfaqe bruto 140.2 m2 nga te cilat 118.9 m2 siperfaqe neto. Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, salloni ndenjes bashke me kendin e gatimit, 2 dhomat e gjumit, 2 tualete, 1 garderobe dhe 2 ballkone. Cmimi i shitjes se prones eshte 25.000.000 Leke te reja. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje nga zonat me te preferuara per banim duke qene se ndodhet prane dy liqeneve. Ajri i paster dhe qetesia ne zone e ben nga me te kerkuarat per nje jetese komode dhe te qete. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote dhe te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: Near Lake I Thate, Super Apartment 2+1+2 With Perfect Spaces Ideal For Living!!!
description_en: Near Lake I Thate, Super Apartment 2+1+2 With Perfect Spaces Ideal For Living!!! The apartment is located on the 3rd residential floor of a 6-story building and has a gross area of ​​140.2 m2, of which 118.9 m2 is a net area. It is organized by the distribution corridor, the living room with the kitchen corner, 2 bedrooms, 2 toilets, 1 wardrobe and 2 balconies. The sale price of the property is 25,000,000 new Lek. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most preferred areas for living, since it is located near two lakes. The clean air and tranquility in the area make it one of the most sought after for a comfortable and peaceful life. The property has complete and regular mortgage documentation.
